signIn.title: Sign in to Nemo Anki
signIn.hint: New here? Same form — we'll create your account when you verify.

decks.title: Your decks
decks.noDecksHint: Create your first deck below, then add cards or use Import. You can nest decks (e.g. German :: A1 :: Lesson 1) by picking a parent.
decks.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}" and all its cards? This can't be undone.
decks.confirmDeleteWithChildren: Delete "{{name}}" and its {{count}} sub-deck(s) and all its cards? This can't be undone.

import.title: Import
import.textPlaceholder:
Paste a word list or passage, e.g.
der Tisch — table
die Lampe — lamp
import.noBooks: No processed books yet. Upload one on the Books page.
import.ankiHelp: AnkiWeb has no import link, so export your deck from Anki (File → Export → Anki Deck Package) and upload the .apkg here. Study progress is preserved; cloze notes become grammar cards and reversed notes become two-sided vocab.
import.ankiSuccess: ✓ Imported {{cards}} cards ({{notes}} notes, {{reversed}} reversed) across {{decks}} deck(s).
import.ankiTruncated: Note: only the first {{max}} notes were imported (the rest were skipped to stay within limits).

study.allDoneHint: No more cards due in this deck. Come back later — or add more.

books.title: Books
books.uploadHint: Upload the book first — then open it to split the PDF into lessons (and re-split into smaller chunks whenever you like).
books.errorUpload: Add a title and choose a file (.txt / .pdf).
books.noBooks: No books yet — upload one above.
books.noShared: No books shared with you yet.
books.confirmDelete: Delete the book "{{title}}"? (Decks you already imported stay.)

writing.title: Writing
writing.subtitle: Practise free writing, get it corrected, and turn each mistake into a sentence card.
writing.addHint: Add any of them to "Writing problems ({{lang}})".
writing.savedHint: Saved cards live in your decks — open Decks to study them.
writing.noBooksHint: No processed books yet — go to Books and process a book first, then come back here.

deckCards.searchPlaceholder: Search cards — front, translation, or reading…

activity.msgGreat: Great work today!{{streak}} Keep the momentum going.
activity.msgStreak: Don't break your {{count}}-day streak 🔥 — review a few cards today!
activity.msgWelcomeBack: Welcome back — a few reviews today restarts your streak.
activity.msgStart: Study a deck to start your streak. A little every day goes a long way!

bookPage.shareHint: Anyone you share with can view the lessons and review them in their own decks.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.subtitle: Practise speaking in your target language — chat freely or read a passage aloud.
conversation.speakHint: Press the mic button and start speaking in {{lang}}.
conversation.noSpeechSupport: Your browser does not support speech recognition. Please use Chrome or Edge.

subscription.tierDiff: Both tiers include every feature — Pro just gives you a higher daily AI limit.
subscription.pageSubtitle: One subscription, all features. Choose a duration.
subscription.statusTrial: You're on a free trial — {{days}} days left.
subscription.statusActive: Your subscription is active — {{days}} days left.
subscription.statusExpired: You don't have an active subscription right now.
subscription.statusPending: We've received your payment note. An admin will verify it and activate your subscription within 24 hours.
subscription.payIntro: Transfer the amount below to this wallet on the {{network}} network, then tap “I've transferred”.
subscription.txLabel: Your wallet address or transaction hash
subscription.txPlaceholder: 0x… — the wallet you paid from, or the transaction hash
subscription.txHint: After transferring, paste the wallet address you paid from or the transaction hash so an admin can verify your payment.
subscription.paidThanks: Thanks! An admin will verify your payment and activate your subscription within 24 hours.
